package.name: rgbd_to_velocity
package.description: ROS 2 port (P08) of the UF REEF rgbd_to_velocity converter (b7637198): RGB-D odometry (cam_to_init) to body-level velocity (reef_msgs/DeltaToVel) for the REEF estimator. Faithful to the legacy math (docs/VISION.md).
package.author: UF REEF Autonomous Vehicles Lab (original ROS 1 package)
